text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the end of lunch break, I saw Rice 
Shower in the courtyard and asked her what 
was going on—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I was playing hide-and-seek, but 
I haven't been able to find them yet...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know I should say it's time to stop... 
but that would ruin our game of 
hide-and-seek...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, Urara-chan might tell us 
'I'm not playing with you anymore'—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, before the lunch break chime rings... 
I definitely have to find it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Rice Shower tracked down Haru 
Urara through sheer willpower, but it 
seemed to have completely drained her 
stamina...
